answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Reaching the umber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the meadow of a task receipt, and the pearl is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
